$comment: Block catalog v1 — EDITABLE SOURCE (architecture.md section 10). A block = id + layer + params schema + render contract + geometry source + gates. Adding a block = a new catalog entry + its renderer + its gates; never an engine fork. video-producer may PROPOSE a new block by editing this catalog; the proposal lands as a plan delta the user approves.

blocks.description: Animated dashes + terse label over elements that WILL change (the approved v1-v3 design language: 'Sort X before Y', 'Change X color', 'Hide Z').
blocks.geometry_source: per-frame logged bboxes from capture meta
blocks.render_contract: browser-rendered transparent asset track keyed to frame ranges; never ffmpeg drawtext (this host's ffmpeg has no drawtext/subtitles/ass)

blocks.description: Visible pointer + click ripples + touch indicators driven by the harness's REAL per-frame input coordinates (v2 measured max deviation 0.0044 px). A decorative overlay teaches nothing — this block is a capture property, not a post overlay.
blocks.render_contract: harness-rendered during capture; recorded to per-frame coord logs so G-POINTER audits fidelity including inside zoom windows

blocks.description: Appears the INSTANT the result does — no dead seconds (the v2-to-v3 fix; dead air cost v2 ~10-15 s).
blocks.geometry_source: measured result-landed frame index (from the beat's assert actions)
blocks.render_contract: browser-rendered overlay keyed to the measured frame index
